episodes.title: 98 – Anneke Lucas: Surviving Trafficking & the Quest for Love
episodes.description: Hello, and welcome to Entangled! The podcast where we explore the science of consciousness, the true nature of reality, and what it means to be a spiritual being having a human experience. I’m your host Jordan Youkilis, and today I’m joined by Anneke Lucas, author, speaker, survivor and advocate for child sex trafficking victims. In this conversation, Anneke describes how family members and associates trafficked her to Belgian pedophile networks in Anneke’s early childhood in the 1960s and 70s. Next, Anneke describes the 1972 Bilderberg meeting, and how a billionaire there took interest in her, leading to a year of being trafficked by global elites. We then discuss Anneke’s final year back in the Belgian trafficking network when she was age 10-11. Anneke explains the connection between the occult and materialism, and we consider the network’s evolution from Biblical times to present day. Anneke describes the abuses of Josef Mengele, and how via Operation Paperclip he and other Nazi scientists continued their “MK” mind-control atrocities after WW II. From there, we discuss the cabal’s use of attachment bonding to enslave victims. Anneke describes her pivotal relationships with two men in the final year of her trafficking: Patrick & Peter. Anneke then explains how she survived once she escaped the cult. We discuss the process of reintegrating suppressed memories. Anneke next explains Belgium’s Dutroux Affair, and how the information disclosed in the Epstein files continues to shove the evidence of elite trafficking networks in our faces. She highlights how this is part of the thrill of psychopaths, who abide by Aleister Crowley’s philosophy of, ‘Do as thou wilt’. We then discuss how real events are shown in works of fiction as a way to discredit survivors. Anneke describes how she came forward with her abuse starting in 2013, and how she got involved in working with prisoners. We discuss the rise in global consciousness since the time of Anneke’s abuse, and how the public is no longer easily fooled. We conclude this episode discussing synchronicity, Christianity, and the wisdom religions. Outros available for this and all episodes at entangledpodcast.substack.com, with supporting exhibits and footnotes. Music from the show available on the Spotify playlist “ Entangled – The Vibes ”.
